## Line Breakdown

<!--
Split the lines added/removed against the PR's base branch (`git diff --numstat <base>...HEAD`) so reviewers can see how much of the diff is production code. Rows must sum to the total; delete rows with no changes.
- Production code: non-comment lines in non-test source (`src/`, `eslint-rules/`, `scripts/`)
- Comments: comment-only lines (`//`, `/* */`, JSDoc, JSX `{/* */}`) in that same source
- Tests: all lines in `*.test.ts(x)`, snapshots, and `tests/` (E2E specs, helpers, fixtures)
- Docs: Markdown files and `docs/`
- Config / CI / tooling: `.github/`, `package.json`, and root config files
- Generated / lockfiles: `src/api/*.gen.ts` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`
-->
